Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the 0x13C80 IOCTL in the BwOpcTool subsystem. When parsing the NamedObject structure, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer.
